emailCc.title: Email Copies (CC / BCC)
emailCc.description: Send a copy of transactional emails to your own team — for example, every invoice to your accounts inbox. Copies are off unless you turn on both this setting and the individual emails below.
emailCc.noneSelected: No emails are selected below, so no copies will be sent.
emailCc.noAddresses: No addresses have been added, so no copies will be sent. Type an address and press Enter to add it.
emailCc.copyTypeHint: BCC keeps your team's addresses hidden. CC shows them to the learner on the email — only use CC if the learner should see who else received it.
emailCc.alwaysCopyHint: Added to every email you switch on below. Leave empty to set addresses per email instead.
emailCc.alsoCopyTo: Also copy to — in addition to the addresses above
emailCc.notRecorded: Copies are not recorded against the recipient in email reports, and replies from a copied address are not tracked.
emailCc.invalidEmail: "{{value}}" is not a valid email address.

controls.controlsHint: Optional. Cap how many emails this sender may send per day (overflow is queued for the next day) and add the unsubscribe footer required for commercial email.
controls.postalAddressPlaceholder: Required by CAN-SPAM for commercial email
controls.listUnsubscribe: Add unsubscribe link and headers to every email from this sender
controls.listUnsubscribeHint: Promotional emails always get them; turn this on to add them to other purposes too.
controls.rampEnabled: Warm up gradually (recommended for a new domain)
controls.rampEnabledHint: Start small and raise the daily limit on a schedule. Mailbox providers judge a new sending domain on how its volume grows; anything over the day's limit is queued for the next window, not dropped.
controls.rampStartedOn: Warm-up started {{date}}. The schedule follows the calendar, so pausing does not bank extra volume.
controls.skipWeekends: Don't send on Saturday or Sunday
controls.maxPerDayManaged: Max emails per day (set by the warm-up schedule)
